lines.text: David asks God to cast down the nations and put his songs in God's bottle, and his enemies will retreat.

problems.problem: Its true detail "his enemies will retreat" isn't in Psalm 56:9 word for word.
Its wrong detail "his enemies will surround him" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
